intro_01.speaker: oliver
intro_01.text: Does this one go to Clover Market?

intro_02.speaker: oliver
intro_02.text: Oh, good. My flowers are beginning to think I made it up.

prologue_rin_02.speaker: rin
prologue_rin_02.text: Brass knows the way. You look after the passengers.

prologue_rin_03.speaker: rin
prologue_rin_03.text: The Last Stop. We used to have supper there when the lamps came on.

prologue_rin_04.speaker: rin
prologue_rin_04.text: I thought I'd mend a few things. See who turns up.
